response.text: Hi. Your goal is to set up a two-way contact sync between HubSpot and the PostgreSQL users table so that new signups appear in HubSpot within 5 minutes and lifecycle stage changes in HubSpot are written back to PostgreSQL, with recent updates winning and conflicts logged. Here is my plan: 1. Kickoff and API credential setup for HubSpot and PostgreSQL. 2. Build one-way signup sync from PostgreSQL to HubSpot within 5 minutes. I did nearly this for a store owner: Stock synced every 15 minutes, with no oversold orders in the first month. What specific hosting environment or OS should the server run the script on? Let us chat about the full plan which includes building the write-back, implementing last-write-wins conflict resolution, and deploying on your server with a README.
